name: rib_in_the_hollowed_box
why: ENTRY W1.2. The shape of the example in the guide (Get_Rib_Feature_Data_Example_CSharp.htm: Shell1, Plane1, Rib1): a hollowed box with the rib on the middle plane. It is the case in which the right direction of the material is the FLIPPED one -- the probe of 28/9/2026 (lines S1/S2) saw it born only that way -- so here the first attempt of the operation (straight) does nothing and the second must succeed. It is the only place where the two attempts on the SAME part are measured: the probe made a new part per line.
_the_numbers: Box 40 x 40 x 20 = 32000; hollowed from the top with walls of 2: the void is 36 x 36 x 18 = 23328, leaving 8672 (as in the probe). The line is on the right plane (x = 0) at y = 12, that is 10 mm above the bottom (which ends at y = 2), from z = -15 to z = 15; extended it touches the two inner walls at z = -18 and z = 18. The rib fills 36 x 10 and, 2 thick, makes +720: 8672 -> 9392, measured.
defect_caught: An operation that tried only one direction (the straight one) would here refuse a rib that can be made. One that did not reselect the sketch after the first failed attempt, or that left something of the first attempt lying around, would be seen here and not in the L.

expect.why: THE BOX GROWS ALONG +Y FROM y = 0 (the top plane is XZ, normal +Y): the line of step 3 is written at y = 12 counting on this. If this is red, the rib is not to blame.

expect.tolerance_why: the shell is read from GetMassProperties in cubic metres: 8672 exact on paper, 8672 to the thousandth in the part (whole bench of 28/9/2026, red without tolerance)
the volume is read from GetMassProperties in cubic metres; the probe measured +720 to the tenth
the same number read from the state instead of from the answer

expect.why: in the box the probe saw it born only with the flipped material: it is the opposite direction from that of the L
the first direction (straight) makes nothing, the second does
without «distance_mm» the sketch is on the right plane, no new plane
extrusion, shell and rib: the first failed attempt did not leave a second rib
